name: Dezaki postcard memories
summary: Brushy 1970s TV cels that freeze and dissolve into chalk-pastel painted stills with cross-hatched shadow, under stark spotlight and split screens.

traits.line: brushy, expressive dark lines of varying weight (Akio Sugino; Shingo Araki and Michi Himeno on Rose of Versailles)
traits.shading: flat cel colour in motion; in the freeze frame ('postcard memory' / harmony cel) a repaint with heavy shadow and cross-hatching
traits.palette: pastel chalk tones in the postcard stills; warm sepia and dusk orange; muted 1970s cel colours elsewhere
traits.lighting: stark spotlight and hard backlight, sun-flare glints, soft-focus sparkle
traits.faces: Sugino's long angular boxers; Araki-Himeno elegant faces with large starry eyes and long lashes
traits.backgrounds: simple painted backgrounds, sometimes dropped to flat colour or pastel wash behind a freeze
traits.texture: chalk-pastel and gouache grain on the stills, 16mm film grain
traits.camera: split screens, dutch angles, the same action repeated in quick succession, multiplane depth

style_words: 1970s TV cel animation in Osamu Dezaki's manner, as in Ashita no Joe (1970) and The Rose of Versailles (1979): brushy expressive dark lines, flat cel colour, freeze frames that dissolve into chalk-pastel painted stills with cross-hatched shadow, stark spotlight and backlight, sparkle glints, warm sepia and dusk tones, gouache texture, 16mm film grain.
avoid: clean modern digital line with no painterly freeze-frame texture
soft generic shoujo pastel without the hard cross-hatched shadow
high frame-rate fluid look; this style holds and freezes
turning into a full oil painting with no cel origin

krea2.style: 1970s TV cel animation in Osamu Dezaki's manner: brushy expressive dark lines of varying weight, flat cel colour, a held freeze frame repainted as a chalk-and-gouache still with hard cross-hatched shadow, stark spotlight and hard backlight, sparkle glints, warm sepia and dusk orange tones, coarse film grain.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as 1970s TV cel animation with brushy dark lines and coarse film grain.

flux3_klein.style: 1970s TV anime cel animation in the register of Osamu Dezaki: brushy, expressive dark lines of varying weight, flat cel colour, the frame held as a freeze frame repainted as a chalk-pastel still with heavy shadow and cross-hatching, stark spotlight and hard backlight, small sparkle glints on edges, chalk-pastel and gouache grain, 16mm film grain, the cel line still visible under the painted texture.
flux3_klein.recap: Warm sepia and dusk orange fill the sky, the walls and the ground, pale chalk-pastel tones stay in the lit areas, the shadow fills are dark brown cross-hatched with black, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.
